case: Ames v. Ohio Dept. of Youth Services
title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Ames in Ames v. Ohio Department of Youth Services
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Ames v. Ohio Department of Youth Services, rules in favor of petitioners and eliminates, or no longer requires, the “background circumstances” rule for majority-group plaintiffs, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of TikTok?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules that the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act is unconstitutional as applied to TikTok Inc. and ByteDance, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Monsanto Company in Monsanto Company v. Durnell
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Monsanto Company v. Durnell, rules that FIFRA preempts label-based failure-to-warn claims where EPA has not required the warning, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of The State of Louisiana in Louisiana v. Callais
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Louisiana v. Callais, rules to significantly weaken or eliminate Section 2 vote dilution protections, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Blom Bank in Blom Bank SAL v. Honickman, et al.
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Blom Bank SAL v. Honickman, et al., rules in favor of petitioner, finding that Rule 60(b)(6) relief was wrongly granted, including because Rule 60(b)(6)'s stringent standard applies to a post-judgment request to vacate for the purpose of filing an amended complaint, then the market resolves to Yes.

case: Catholic Charities Bureau v. Wisconsin LIRC
title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Catholic Charities Bureau in Catholic Charities Bureau v. Wisconsin
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Catholic Charities Bureau v. Wisconsin, rules in favor of petitioner, including by finding that a state violates the First Amendment's Religion Clauses by denying a religious organization an otherwise-available tax exemption because the organization does not meet the state's criteria for religious behavior, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: What will the Supreme Court rule in Students for Fair Admissions v. Harvard?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court ruling in Students for Fair Admissions Inc. v President & Fellows of Harvard College is a complete victory for the plaintiffs (Students for Fair Admissions Inc.), then the market resolves to Yes.

case: National Pork Producers Council v. Ross
title: Will the Supreme Court strike down Proposition 12 in National Pork Producers Council v. Ross?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court strikes down California's Proposition 12 in National Pork Producers Council v. Ross, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Devas in Devas v. Antrix Corp.
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Devas v. Antrix Corp., rules in favor of petitioner, finding that plaintiffs must not prove minimum contacts before federal courts may assert personal jurisdiction over foreign states sued under the Foreign Sovereign Immunities Act, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the USSC rule that Congress did not impliedly strip federal courts of jurisdiction to adjudicate constitutional challenges to the structure of the FTC in Axon. v. FTC?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules that Congress did not impliedly strip federal district courts of jurisdiction over constitutional challenges to (at least one of or a subset of) the Federal Trade Commission’s structure, procedures, or existence, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Barnes in Barnes v. Felix
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Barnes v. Felix, rules in favor of petitioner and rejects the “moment of the threat” doctrine when evaluating an excessive force claim under the Fourth Amendment, or otherwise favors the Petitioner’s position that all relevant circumstances must be considered, then the market resolves to Yes.

case: City of Grants Pass v. Johnson
title: SCOTUS rules homeless regulations legal?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules that enforcement of generally applicable laws regulating camping on public property is constitutionally permissible, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule that the government violated social media companies' First Amendment rights?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules that the government violated the First Amendment, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of RFK and HHS in Becerra v. Braidwood Management
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Becerra v. Braidwood Management, rules in favor of petitioner and finds that the court of appeals erred in holding that the structure of the Task Force violates the Appointments Clause, U.S. Const. Art. II, § 2, Cl. 2, and/or in declining to sever the statutory provision that it found to unduly insulate the Task Force from the HHS Secretary’s supervision, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Okello T. Chatrie in Chatrie v. United States
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Chatrie v. United States, rules the execution of the geofence warrant violated the Fourth Amendment, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court’s ruling in Gonzalez v. Google rule that Section 230 does not immunize ICS algorithms?
rules_primary: If, in Gonzalez v. Google, the Supreme Court rules that Section 230(c)(1) of the Communications Decency Act does not fully immunize Google’s use of making targeted recommendations of information provided by another information content provider, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the injunction on student loan forgiveness be lifted in Biden v. Nebraska?
rules_primary: If, in Biden v. Nebraska, the Supreme Court vacates or otherwise lifts the injunction placed by the Eighth Circuit enjoining the United States Secretary of Education from implementing its plan to discharge student loan debt under the Higher Education Relief Opportunities for Students Act of 2003, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of the plaintiffs in **Carson v. Makin** on constitutional grounds?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules in favor of the plaintiff on constitutional grounds in Carson v. Makin, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule that banning gender-affirming surgery for minors is unconstitutional?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules in US v. Skrmetti that Tennessee Bill 1 violates the Constitution, then the market resolves to Yes.

case: CFPB v. Community Financial Services Assn.
title: WIll the CFPB's funding structure be found to be illegal by the SCOTUS?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court finds that the CFPB funding structure is unconstitutional, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Trump in Trump v. Slaughter
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Trump v. Slaughter, rules to overturn Humphrey's Executor v. United States, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of The United States in United States v. Hemani
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in United States v. Hemani, rules that the federal government may continue to bar marijuana users from buying or possessing firearms under 18 U.S.C. § 922(g)(3), then the market resolves to Yes.

title: SCOTUS strikes down Texas bill regulating social media?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules that Texas House Bill 20 violates the First Amendment, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Trump in V.O.S. Selections, Inc. v. Trump
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in V.O.S. Selections, Inc. v. Trump, rules that Trump's tariffs are legal before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule against the constitutionality of the mandatory repatriation tax in Moore v. US?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules the mandatory repatriation tax unconstitutional, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of the petitioners in Loper Bright v. Raimondo?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules in favor of the petitioners in Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo et al., then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of National Republican Senatorial Committee in NRSC v. FEC
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in NRSC v. FEC, rules the federal limits on coordinated party expenditures violate the First Amendment, either facially or as applied to party coordinated communications, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of A.J.T. in A.J.T. v. Osseo Area Schools
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in A.J.T. v. Osseo Area Schools, rules in favor of petitioner, rejecting the heightened 'bad faith or gross misjudgment' standard for Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 and Rehabilitation Act of 1973 school cases, then the market resolves to Yes.

case: Advocate Christ Medical Center v. Kennedy (Becerra)
title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Advocate Christ Medical Center in Advocate Christ Medical Center v. Becerra
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Advocate Christ Medical Center v. Becerra, rules in favor of petitioners’ interpretation that “entitled to…SSI benefits” includes all who meet SSI eligibility, whether or not they received an SSI payment., then the market resolves to Yes.

case: FDA v. Wages and White Lion Investments
title: Will the Supreme Court rule against the FDA's flavored vape ban?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules in FDA v. Wages and White Lion Investments that the FDA's rejection of plaintiff's flavored e-cigarette application was arbitrary and capricious, then the market resolves to Yes.

case: Little v. Hecox / West Virginia v. B.P.J.
title: Will the Supreme Court uphold transgender sports bans?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in West Virginia v. B.P.J. or Little v. Hecox, rules to uphold state laws restricting transgender athletes in sports, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Donald J. Trump in Trump v. Miot
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Trump v. Miot, rules that the Secretary of Homeland Security may terminate Haiti’s Temporary Protected Status designation notwithstanding respondents’ APA and equal-protection challenges, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of Jason Wolford in Wolford v. Lopez
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Wolford v. Lopez, rules Hawaii may not presumptively prohibit licensed concealed-carry permit holders from carrying handguns on private property open to the public unless the property owner affirmatively gives express permission, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will SCOTUS bar counting mail ballots received after Election Day?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court, in Watson v. Republican National Committee, rules before Aug 1, 2026 that the federal election-day statutes preempt a state law that allows ballots cast by federal Election Day to be received (and counted) after Election Day, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will USSC rule NLRA does not preempt a state tort claim in Glacier Northwest vs International Brotherhood of Teamsters?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules in Glacier Northwest v. International Brotherhood of Teamsters that the National Labor Relations Act does not preempt state tort claims against the International Brotherhood of Teamsters for intentionally destroying an employer’s property in the course of their labor dispute with Glacier Northwest Inc., then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of 'ghost gun' regulation?
rules_primary: If the Supreme Court rules in favor of Garland in Garland v. VanDerStok, then the market resolves to Yes.
